Cities FAQ

Cities FAQ

01

My suburb is not listed—can you still come?

Usually yes. Metro pages cover the wider urban area. Call 1-800-POWER-CA with your street address or postal code.

02

Why is each city one link?

The hub lists one entry per metro. That page routes to commercial electrical service locally; national service pages cover all of Canada.

03

Do you work after hours?

Yes—emergency electrical and panel faults run 24/7. Planned upgrades and installs are scheduled with ESA lead times.

⚡ Live dispatch

Between cities on the highway?

Call from the road with your nearest exit or GPS—dispatch uses the closest provincial hub.
